sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेषामधर्मे चानृते च ह ।ततः पूर्वे भृशं ह्रासमगमन्नृपसत्तम ।। ७.७४.२२ ॥
transliteration: etasminnantare teṣāmadharme cānṛte ca ha ।tataḥ pūrve bhṛśaṁ hrāsamagamannṛpasattama ।। 7.74.22 ॥

translations.english: O best of kings, in this interval, as unrighteousness and falsehood increased among the people, the former state of righteousness greatly diminished.
translations.hindi: आध ! तुम्हारा मनुष्यभाव दयालुता से पर्ण है) आशिया पर तुम्हारी बड़ी दयामया रहती हे, अंतए दयालु राजा हो
